tarotPage.tarotOriginBody: Tarot is a 78-card divination system from Europe, made of 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana. Each card carries a symbol, and a reading connects that symbol to your question.
tarotPage.lenormandOriginBody:
Lenormand is a 36-card deck named after the late-18th-century French cartomancer Mademoiselle Lenormand.
Everyday objects, animals, and nature appear as cards.
Meaning emerges from how adjacent cards combine.
tarotPage.runeOriginBody: The Elder Futhark is a set of 24 runes used in Northern European divination. A single rune can point to a theme, warning, or next step.

personalityTypes.ISTJ_summary: A thorough, deeply responsible realist. Values rules and duty.
personalityTypes.ISTJ_description:
ISTJs have diligence and reliability baked in.
Once they take on a task they see it through, and they almost never break a promise.
They prioritize facts and logic over emotion and trust traditions that have stood the test of time.
They can look cool on the outside, but on the inside they care deeply about the people around them.
ISTJ_strengths: Strong sense of responsibility and diligence
personalityTypes.ISTJ_imageRole: A military strategist reading the star maps
personalityTypes.ISFJ_summary: A quiet protector with a devoted, warm heart.
personalityTypes.ISFJ_description:
ISFJs instinctively pick up on what people around them need and help out quietly.
They have great memories for the little preferences and special days of those close to them.
They tend to put others first and treasure stable settings and deep relationships.
They prefer the familiar over sudden change.
ISFJ_cautions: Take care of your own feelings and needs
Practice saying no when you mean it
personalityTypes.INFJ_summary: A rare insight-keeper who quietly moves toward an ideal.
personalityTypes.INFJ_description:
INFJs are one of the rarest types.
They have an uncanny read on others and deep empathy at the same time.
They need solitude, yet they also want to leave a positive mark on the world.
For values they believe in, they can work with quiet determination for a very long time.
INFJ_cautions: Loosen the grip of perfectionism a little
Watch for burnout from pushing too hard
personalityTypes.INTJ_description:
INTJs see through complex systems and patterns with sharp strategic thinking.
They enjoy deep solo analysis and hold themselves and others to high standards.
Inefficiency drives them up the wall, and they trust their own judgment strongly.
They can look cold on the surface but bring surprising passion to areas they choose.
INTJ_cautions: Stay flexible when the situation calls for it
Make more space for emotional connection
personalityTypes.INTJ_imageRole: A military strategist reading the star maps · A chess-style tactician
personalityTypes.ISTP_summary: A practical, level-headed observer. Loves solving things hands-on.
personalityTypes.ISTP_description:
ISTPs stay calm under almost any circumstance and find optimal solutions.
They love tools and machines, fixing things with their hands, and have a great spatial sense.
They'd rather solve problems their own way than follow unnecessary rules.
They shine brightest in a crisis.
ISTP_cautions: Build the habit of long-range planning
personalityTypes.ISFP_summary: A quiet, warm sensibility — a present-moment explorer.
personalityTypes.ISFP_description:
ISFPs may not draw attention to themselves, but they see the world through eyes attuned to beauty and harmony.
They express themselves in their own original way and find real happiness in life's small moments.
They lean toward cooperation over competition, and harmony over argument.
ISFP_strengths: Warm, open mind free of judgment
ISFP_cautions: Speak up for your own view more actively
personalityTypes.INFP_summary: A quiet idealist with deep feeling and conviction.
personalityTypes.INFP_description:
INFPs hold their own values and ideals above almost everything else.
They're quiet on the outside but carry a rich, complex inner world.
They pursue genuine relationships and a meaningful life, and they quietly want to leave the world a little better.
Writing, art, music — these are how they let their inner world out.
INFP_cautions: Find balance with the practical side
Watch for burnout from emotional overinvestment
personalityTypes.INTP_summary: A quiet innovator who analyzes the world with endless curiosity.
personalityTypes.INTP_description:
INTPs want to understand and explain everything.
They enjoy complex theories and concepts and have an unusual talent for spotting logical holes.
Solo thinking time is more comfortable than chatting, and sometimes their heads are so full of ideas that execution lags.
They want to contribute original ideas that flip received wisdom on its head.
INTP_strengths: Original thinking that breaks old molds
Objective judgment that doesn't sway with emotion
INTP_cautions: Practice moving from thinking to doing
Tend to relationships and communication too
personalityTypes.ESTP_summary: An energetic, realistic doer who lives in the moment.
personalityTypes.ESTP_description:
ESTPs are natural executors who spot the opportunity and act on it in any situation.
They don't fear risk — they enjoy the thrill — and their reflexes and snap judgment are excellent.
They'd rather learn by doing than by theory, and they have a natural ability to set the tone in a group.
personalityTypes.ESFP_summary: A lively, spontaneous spreader of life's joys.
personalityTypes.ESFP_description:
ESFPs liven up every room they enter — natural entertainers.
They treat life itself as a stage and love being with people, making fun moments together.
They live in the present and treasure current experience over future planning.
They have an uncanny ability to make the people around them happy.
ESFP_strengths: Genuine ability to enjoy the moment
ESFP_cautions: Plan for the longer term too
Make space for serious, deeper conversations sometimes
personalityTypes.ENFP_summary: A free spirit full of imagination and passion.
personalityTypes.ENFP_description:
ENFPs see the world as full of possibility — bright optimists.
They get excited by new ideas and people easily, and their enthusiasm tends to inspire those around them.
With deep understanding of people and strong empathy, they make friends quickly.
The flip side: they care about so much that focusing on one thing can be hard.
personalityTypes.ENTP_summary: A creative innovator who enjoys a challenge and never runs out of ideas.
personalityTypes.ENTP_description:
ENTPs challenge existing molds and pour out new ideas nonstop.
They enjoy intellectual debate and confidently make their case against opposing views.
They're broadly curious and love finding ways to make the impossible possible.
Plenty of ideas — sometimes weaker on execution and follow-through.
ENTP_cautions: Build the habit of finishing things you start
Watch the other side's feelings during debate
personalityTypes.ESTJ_summary: A natural leader who values structure and order.
personalityTypes.ESTJ_description:
ESTJs treat keeping order and rules in the community as their mission — natural organizers.
They set clear goals and execute systematically, and their sense of responsibility wins trust.
They value tradition and proven methods, and have little patience for inefficiency.
They shine in leadership roles.
ESTJ_cautions: Flex with the situation when needed
personalityTypes.ESTJ_imageRole: City administrator · Keeper of law and order
personalityTypes.ESFJ_summary: A warm diplomat who takes care of others and seeks harmony.
personalityTypes.ESFJ_description:
ESFJs pick up on what people around them need and look after them — warm by nature.
They're great at setting a tone where people mix well, and they naturally play mediator in conflicts.
They gain energy from being acknowledged and appreciated, and they treasure tradition and community.
ESFJ_cautions: Put your own needs and feelings first sometimes
Practice relying less on others' evaluation
personalityTypes.ENFJ_summary: A charismatic born leader who grows others.
personalityTypes.ENFJ_description:
ENFJs find real fulfillment in others' growth and development — natural mentors.
With strong verbal skill and empathy they inspire people and lead a whole group toward a goal.
They sense others' feelings instinctively and know what to say.
The risk: they pour themselves out for others and run their own tank dry.
ENFJ_strengths: The power to bind people and community together
ENFJ_cautions: Take care of your own energy and feelings too
Watch out for over-dependence from others
personalityTypes.ENTJ_summary: A charismatic strategic leader. Moves toward goals without flinching.
personalityTypes.ENTJ_description:
ENTJs set goals and mobilize every resource to reach them — natural commanders.
They can't stand the inefficient and always look for a better way.
With strong confidence and decisiveness they hold steady in a crisis and lead.
They carry long-range vision and can turn seemingly impossible goals into achievable plans.
ENTJ_cautions: Watch the feelings of those moving with you
Pace the process as much as you push the goal
